dialogues.speaker: Aged Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: (An old stone tablet. The words inscribed upon it have become blurred beyond intelligibility...)

dialogues.speaker: Aged Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: "...<color=#00E1FFFF>As far up as in front of the stone wall, and as far down as the banks of the shallow bay</color>, there are symbols of four different elements..."

dialogues.speaker: Aged Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: "...Light them up <color=#00E1FFFF>from top to bottom</color>... Once this is done, <color=#00E1FFFF>the skies will undergo four corresponding changes</color>..."

dialogues.speaker: Aged Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: "...After this, the central gate will open..."
